Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: ember bolt
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: A focused flame strike. Can damage any targeted pawn, including allies.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: frost shard
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: A chilling shard that deals damage and slows any targeted pawn.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: storm spark
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: A crackling spell that deals damage and disrupts any targeted pawn.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: verdant mend
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Heal an injured pawn, whether ally or enemy.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: guardian ward
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Grant a temporary protective ward to any targeted pawn.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: stone skin
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Gain temporary armor with a small movement penalty.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: swift step
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Move faster for a short time.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: mist veil
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Gain short-lived evasive footwork; does not grant invisibility.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: keen sight
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Improve aiming and awareness for a short time.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: rallying surge
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Temporarily improve a targeted pawn's speed and work efficiency.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: purifying touch
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Remove an Essencebound chill or static affliction from any targeted pawn.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: force pulse
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Release a brief close-range pulse affecting nearby hostile pawns.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: cinder nova
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: An expanding ring of burning essence damages hostile pawns around the caster.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: thunder chain
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Lightning leaps from the selected pawn to up to two nearby hostile pawns.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: blood siphon
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Deal damage to a chosen pawn and restore some of the caster's existing wounds from effective damage.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: life bloom
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Spread restorative essence across several wounds on a targeted pawn.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: renewal seed
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Plant a regeneration blessing that heals actual wounds every two seconds while active.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: grove shelter
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Create a protective aura around nearby nonhostile pawns that persists as independent wards.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: purging wave
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Clear Essencebound afflictions from nearby nonhostile pawns; no effect on healthy targets.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: gravity snare
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Bind a hostile pawn in slow-moving magical gravity; progress accrues while restrained.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: corrosive strike
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Damage a pawn and briefly reduce sharp and blunt armor with a corrosive affliction.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: echo burst
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Strike a selected pawn and damage nearby hostile pawns with a weaker concussive echo.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: spirit beacon
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Temporarily focus a pawn's accuracy and general work efficiency.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: moonlit reprieve
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Mend an injury and grant a modest protective blessing to the same pawn.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: inferno lance
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Focused long-range flame strikes a single pawn.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: frost halo
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: A freezing impact ring strikes hostile pawns near the caster.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: quakebreaker
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: A targeted ground strike sends weaker tremors to visible nearby enemies.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: zephyr ricochet
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Air blades jump from one pawn to three visible nearby hostiles.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: umbral leech
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Drain vigor from a pawn and repair some of the caster's real injuries.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: viper's bite
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Damage a pawn and leave a slowing venom haze.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: shard volley
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Hardened crystal shards ricochet toward three visible nearby hostiles.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: briar detonation
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Explosive briars damage a selected pawn and entangle nearby visible hostiles.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: starfall
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Celestial impact strikes a selected pawn and concusses nearby hostiles.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: tidal rebuke
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: A short-range tidal shockwave affects hostile pawns near the caster.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: iron bastion
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Harden the caster's armor at the cost of some mobility.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: mirror guard
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Distort reflections around the caster for better dodge and light armor.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: dawn chorus
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Boost nearby nonhostile pawns with a shared movement and work focus.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: verdant sanctuary
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Restore real injuries on up to four nearby wounded allies.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: ocean renewal
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Apply gradual regeneration to up to four nearby wounded allies.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: cleansing ray
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Heal a selected pawn and remove temporary Essencebound afflictions.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: mercy thread
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Heal a chosen pawn and then two nearby wounded allies at lesser strength.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: soul harvest
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Drain nearby visible hostiles and restore some of the caster's injuries.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: rune bind
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Bind a hostile pawn's movement with a temporary controlling rune.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: omen hex
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Hex a hostile pawn to impair shooting accuracy and work speed.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: temporal haste
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Speed the caster's movement and work briefly.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: battlefield focus
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Improve ranged accuracy and evasive movement through combat focus.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: blade tempest
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Emit a close-range ring of cutting essence pressure against hostiles.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: nemesis strike
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Strike a pawn with greater force when it already has significant injuries.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: thread snare
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Strike a pawn with tangled essence that briefly slows its movement.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: glass ward
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Mend a pawn and surround it with protective crystalline armor.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: ashen comet
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Telegraph a falling fiery impact before it hits the map.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: prismatic deflection
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Reflect part of an incoming projectile toward its source.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: lotus sanctum
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Establish a sanctuary that heals wounded allies over time.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: chrono anchor
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Mark a safe tile and return there once before the mark expires.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: wolfpack call
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Summon spectral wolves with a limited lifetime.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: spectral hand
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Manipulate an eligible nearby object at a distance.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: chimeric aspect
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Adapt defense or offense to the most recent threat.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: void slip
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Blink to a reachable safe tile in line of sight.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: fleshweave
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Spend temporary stamina to mend an allied injury.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: tidal wall
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Place a short-lived water obstruction along a chosen line.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: lightning step
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Reposition and release a shock at the landing point.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: sovereign command
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Order controlled allies or summons to focus on a target.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: star map
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Briefly reveal faraway terrain features and points of interest.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: predator mark
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Mark a foe to improve allied precision against that foe.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: hydra bloom
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Send regeneration pulses to multiple wounded pawns.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: crystal prison
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Surround a hostile pawn with temporary crystal obstacles.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: echo twin
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Create a short-lived echo decoy to distract hostiles.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: resonance field
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Strengthen essence damage for allies within a limited field.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: guardian bastion
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Create a dome that reduces incoming ranged attacks.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: molten rain
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Create a temporary burning hazard on selected ground.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: oasis well
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Create an out-of-combat restorative site for nearby allies.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: bone familiar
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Summon a small defensive magical construct companion.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: mistwalk
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Temporarily make movement between cover harder to detect.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: mirror step
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Swap safe positions with a consenting allied pawn.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: web weaver
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Spread temporary webbing that slows hostile passage.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: sonic lance
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Release a focused sonic attack effective against light armor.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: sunward flare
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Remove darkness afflictions and emit a radiant burst.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: moonshadow
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Gain additional evasion under dim light.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: hunger field
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Drain nearby hostile life while a channelled field lasts.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: shatter armor
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Reduce target armor durability based on a direct blow.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: harvest blessing
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Improve nearby plant harvest efficiency for a short time.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: weave ward
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Link two allies so protective boons share incoming harm.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: rune beacon
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Place a rune that grants defense to pawns within range.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: iron reprisal
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Retaliate against nearby hostile melee attacks for a duration.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: serpent coil
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Restrict enemy movement and offensive accuracy.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: dawn rebirth
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Trigger an emergency healing surge during a dangerous fight.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: adept convergence
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Temporarily redirect one attribute bonus into another.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: fey glamour
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Disrupt hostile targeting through illusory movement.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: nimbus guard
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Protect a moving pawn with a limited-duration storm shield.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: blade orbit
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Orbit enchanted blades that hit nearby hostiles periodically.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: gravity well
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Draw hostiles toward the center of a short-lived gravity field.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: corrupting seed
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Deal periodic damage while reducing target armor.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: talisman seal
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Store a defensive spell that triggers at the next threat.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: pact of unity
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Connect nearby allies for a temporary cooperative skill bonus.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: phoenix ashes
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Aid a severely injured pawn with a protective renewal boon.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: worldstep
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Travel to a marked safe cell after a longer channel.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: feral claw
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Reward successive close attacks with a stacking offensive bonus.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: ward echo
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Return a portion of enemy control effects back to their caster.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: sands of stillness
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Create a temporary zone that slows hostile movement.

Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.label: tempest flock
Essencebound.EssencePowerDef.description: Conjure a flock of distracting magical birds.
